name: Chicken shawarma bowl
steps: Toss the chicken with cumin, paprika, garlic and a little olive oil.
Sear the chicken in a hot pan until browned and cooked through.
Slice the chicken thinly and rest for a minute.
Warm the rice and spoon into a bowl.
Top with the chicken, cucumber and a dollop of yogurt.
Finish with a squeeze of lemon and a pinch of salt.
